_comment: Optional servers that complement open-stanley. NOT auto-loaded. Copy the entries you want into your project's .mcp.json, or run the equivalent `claude mcp add` commands. Remote servers use OAuth; nothing here needs a secret in the file except where a ${user_config...} placeholder appears.
_claude_mcp_add: claude mcp add --transport http pam https://api.pam.harmix.ai/v1/mcp/memory
claude mcp add --transport http exa https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp
claude mcp add --transport http x https://api.x.com/mcp
claude mcp add --transport http typefully https://mcp.typefully.com/mcp
claude mcp add --transport http fathom https://api.fathom.ai/mcp
claude mcp add --transport http granola https://mcp.granola.ai/mcp
claude mcp add --transport http slack https://mcp.slack.com/mcp
claude mcp add --transport http canva https://mcp.canva.com/mcp
claude mcp add --transport http recraft https://mcp.recraft.ai/mcp
claude mcp add --transport http replicate https://mcp.replicate.com
claude mcp add --transport http supermemory https://mcp.supermemory.ai/mcp

pam._setup: Claude app: Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector, paste the URL, Add, sign in to Pam, Approve memory:read
